Tesla Delivered 22,141 More Vehicles Than It Built in Q3. Here’s the Production Number That Decides What Comes Next

Wiltone Asuncion
Sun, October 4, 2026 at 8:48 AM PDT
  • TSLA

Tesla (TSLA:NASDAQ) delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter of 2026 but built only 464,391, according to its October 2 production and deliveries report. Deliveries beat the company-compiled analyst consensus of around 462,000, and shares closed up 4.65% at $370.59 on October 2.
